opening.quote: Good morning, thank your for calling Tidewell homes, my name is Ruud. How can I help?
opening.comment: You gave your name and the company name in the first turn, which meets the opening standard; the typo 'thank your' and 'homes' versus 'Home' are minor.

verification.quote: Could you tell me your name and order number?
verification.comment: You asked for name and order number only after the caller had already given both, and you did not confirm the caller's identity before sharing order data; the check should have been a confirmation of the full name plus order number before stating the vase details.

understanding.quote: Could you tell me your name and order number?
understanding.comment: The caller had already stated her name and order number, so asking for them again was an avoidable repeat, though the actual issue (smashed vase) was captured.

resolution_accuracy.quote: it arrives in 2 to 4 working days, and as it's unders €25 you don't need to send the broken one back.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The replacement timeline and the under-EUR 25 no-return rule match policy, so the statements are accurate.

process_compliance.quote: I've sent a replacement today, it arrives in 2 to 4 working days
process_compliance.comment: Policy requires asking for a photo before arranging a replacement for a damaged item, and no photo request appears in the call, so this step was missed.

communication.quote: I'm sorry, Eva, that's the horrible thing to unpack.
communication.comment: You were polite and apologetic; the caller was not visibly frustrated, so acknowledgement was adequate.

closing.quote: Your tracking link will come by email tonight. Is there anything else I can help with?
closing.comment: You confirmed the next step and asked if anything else was needed, then closed politely.
